name: Hot & Cold
source:
In this mini novel Hot & Cold, you will be playing the role of a passenger who half-heartedly board a train. A train which will encounter a trouble but that trouble will be a blessing in disguise for him for he will be breathing the air filled with romance.
The choices you face will define the outcome.

[From [url=https://f95zone.to/threads/hot-cold-v0-1-roleplayer.103994/]F95zone[/url]]
translation:
在这部迷你小说《热与冷》中，你将扮演一名漫不经心地登上火车的乘客。一列火车会遇到麻烦，但麻烦对他来说却是因祸得福，因为他呼吸着充满浪漫的空气。
你面临的选择将决定结果。

[来自[url=https://f95zone.to/threads/hot-cold-v0-1-roleplayer.103994/]F95zone[/url]]
